paper_title: Spectrum of global string networks and the axion dark matter mass
suggested_experiment_name: Post-inflationary axion dark matter from global string networks
coupling_convention: m_a in eV (y-axis) vs f_a in GeV (x-axis). This is the AxionMass plane showing the relationship between axion decay constant and axion mass from post-inflationary cosmic string radiation.
notes: This paper presents a theoretical prediction for the axion dark matter mass in the post-inflationary Peccei-Quinn symmetry breaking scenario, derived from large-scale numerical simulations of global cosmic string networks. The main result is m_a ≈ 95–450 μeV (1.2), which represents a range accounting for uncertainties in the spectral index q, string tension parameter ℓ, and discretisation effects. The paper does NOT present an experimental exclusion limit or measured constraint on axion couplings (g_agamma, g_ae, etc.). Instead, it provides a theoretical mass prediction based on cosmological simulations. The data_points encode the predicted mass range as a horizontal band: the coupling values (95e-6 and 450e-6 eV) represent the lower and upper bounds of the predicted axion mass, with arbitrary small mass values (1e-5 eV) used as placeholders on the x-axis since this is a mass-independent (or rather, mass-range-dependent) prediction. This is a projection/prediction, not a new measured limit.
